item.description:
This is the last update to Zscaler Policy Wizard. It's replaced by **zPolicy Wizard 4.0**, one app for macOS and Windows that does everything 3.4 does.
### What to do - **On macOS 15 or later:** [download zPolicy Wizard](https://github.com/ajawzero/zpolicy-wizard-updates/releases/latest/download/zPolicy-Wizard.dmg), drag it to Applications and open it. It asks once whether to copy this app's run records, Config Drift reads, POVs and POV templates, so you can still undo 3.x runs and pick up your POVs. Your vanity domain, cloud and client ID fill in Connect. Enter your client secret once more: it isn't copied. - **On macOS 13 or 14:** keep using this app. It keeps working as it does today, but gets no more updates. - You can keep both apps for a while: zPolicy Wizard never changes this app's files or settings.
### Notes - zPolicy Wizard, like this app, isn't an official Zscaler tool: it's built by a Zscaler SE to help SEs and Zscaler practitioners. - Nothing else changes in this update.
